summary: Module 07 VERIFY: Explained the role of idempotency and retries. Retries introduce duplicate processing risk if a worker crashes/disconnects before acknowledging a completed write. We protect against duplicate clicks via a unique event_key UUID constraint on the database. If analytics fail or the queue is down, the system degrades gracefully without blocking the redirect hot path.
evidence: Idempotency key check: verified unique constraint on event_key column in click_events model.
Graceful degradation: redirect route executes _enqueue_click in a try-except block to prevent queue issues from blocking redirects.
